segments.normalizedSource: ```swift guard let randomGenerator = BNNS.RandomGenerator( method: .aesCtr, seed: 1234) else { return } let state = randomGenerator.state let a = BNNSNDArrayDescriptor.allocate( randomUniformUsing: randomGenerator, range: Int16(-10)...Int16(10), shape: [16])!.makeArray(of: Int16.self)! let b = BNNSNDArrayDescriptor.allocate( randomUniformUsing: randomGenerator, range: Int16(-10)...Int16(10), shape: [16])!.makeArray(of: Int16.self)! // Prints "false". print(a.elementsEqual(b)) randomGenerator.state = state let c = BNNSNDArrayDescriptor.allocate( randomUniformUsing: randomGenerator, range: Int16(-10)...Int16(10), shape: [16])!.makeArray(of: Int16.self)! // Prints "true". print(a.elementsEqual(c)) ```
